#!/usr/bin/env bash

# deploy.sh — Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
# Excludes: node_modules/, .git/
# Usage: ./deploy.sh [output-dir]

set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$PWD")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-releases}"          # Default output folder: ./releases

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Preparation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "==> Creating output directory: ${OUTPUT_DIR}"
mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build archive
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "==> Building archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
tar \
  --exclude="./${OUTPUT_DIR}" \
  --exclude="./node_modules" \
  --exclude="./.git" \
  -czf "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
  .

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summary
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -sh "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" | cut -f1)

echo ""
echo "✅  Release archive created successfully!"
echo "    Path : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
echo "    Size : ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# deploy.sh — Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
# Excludes: node_modules/, .git/
# Usage: ./deploy.sh [output-dir]

set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$PWD")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-releases}"          # Default output folder: ./releases
ENV_FILE=".env.test"                 # Required-variable definitions

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pre-deployment validation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "==> Validating environment variables from ${ENV_FILE}"

# Abort early if the file itself is missing
if [[ ! -f "${ENV_FILE}" ]]; then
  echo "❌  ${ENV_FILE} not found. Cannot validate environment." >&2
  exit 1
fi

MISSING=()   # Keys that are absent from the environment or empty
BLANK=()     # Keys present in the file but with no value assigned

while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "${line}" ]]; do
  # Skip blank lines and comments
  [[ -z "${line}" || "${line}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

  # Extract the key (everything before the first '=')
  key="${line%%=*}"

  # Skip malformed lines that produced an empty key
  [[ -z "${key}" ]] && continue

  # Trim surrounding whitespace from the key
  key="${key#"${key%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
  key="${key%"${key##*[![:space:]]}"}"

  # Grab the raw value from the file (everything after the first '=')
  file_value="${line#*=}"

  # Flag keys whose file value is empty (no default is possible at runtime)
  if [[ -z "${file_value}" ]]; then
    BLANK+=("${key}")
  fi

  # Flag keys that are unset or empty in the current environment
  if [[ -z "${!key+set}" || -z "${!key}" ]]; then
    MISSING+=("${key}")
  fi

done < "${ENV_FILE}"

# Report blank-value keys found in the file
if [[ ${#BLANK[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo ""
  echo "⚠️   The following keys have no value in ${ENV_FILE}:" >&2
  for k in "${BLANK[@]}"; do
    echo "      - ${k}" >&2
  done
fi

# Abort if any required variable is missing from the environment
if [[ ${#MISSING[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo ""
  echo "❌  Pre-deployment validation failed." >&2
  echo "    The following required environment variables are not set:" >&2
  for k in "${MISSING[@]}"; do
    echo "      - ${k}" >&2
  done
  echo ""
  echo "    Export them or source your env file before running this script:" >&2
  echo "      set -a && source ${ENV_FILE} && set +a" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "✅  All $(wc -l < <(grep -cE '^[^#[:space:]][^=]*=' "${ENV_FILE}" || true) ) required variables are set."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Preparation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo ""
echo "==> Creating output directory: ${OUTPUT_DIR}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# deploy.sh – Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
# Usage: ./deploy.sh [project-name]
# Example: ./deploy.sh my-app

set -euo pipefail

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROJECT_NAME="${1:-$(basename "$PWD")}"          # first arg, or current dir name
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"              # e.g. 20240712_153045
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
RELEASES_DIR="releases"                          # where archives are written

# Directories / files to exclude from the archive
EXCLUDES=(
  "./${RELEASES_DIR}"
  "./node_modules"
  "./.git"
  "./.env"
  "./.env.*"
  ".DS_Store"
)

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
warn() { echo "[deploy] WARNING: $*" >&2; }
die()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar &>/dev/null || die "'tar' is required but not installed."

# ── Create releases directory ────────────────────────────────────────────────
mkdir -p "$RELEASES_DIR"
log "Releases directory : ./${RELEASES_DIR}"

# ── Build exclude flags ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EXCLUDE_FLAGS=()
for pattern in "${EXCLUDES[@]}"; do
  EXCLUDE_FLAGS+=("--exclude=${pattern}")
done

# ── Create the archive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ARCHIVE_PATH="${RELEASES_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

log "Creating archive   : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" \
  "${EXCLUDE_FLAGS[@]}"    \
  .

# ── Verify the archive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if tar -tzf "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" &>/dev/null; then
  ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" | cut -f1)"
  log "Archive verified   : OK (${ARCHIVE_SIZE})"
else
  die "Archive verification failed – the file may be corrupt."
fi

# ── Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "────────────────────────────────────────"
log "  Project   : ${PROJECT_NAME}"
log "  Archive   : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
log "  Size      : ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
log "  Timestamp : ${TIMESTAMP}"
log "────────────────────────────────────────"
log "Deployment package ready."

  "./.env"

log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
warn() { echo "[deploy] WARNING: $*" >&2; }
die()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar &>/dev/null || die "'tar' is required but not installed."

# ── Environment variable validation ──────────────────────────────────────────
validate_env() {
  local env_file="$1"
  local missing=()   # keys that are absent from the environment
  local empty=()     # keys present but set to an empty string
  local line key value line_number=0

  log "Validating environment variables from ${env_file} ..."

  [[ -f "$env_file" ]]    || die "Environment file '${env_file}' not found."
  [[ -r "$env_file" ]]    || die "Environment file '${env_file}' is not readable."

  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    (( line_number++ )) || true

    # Skip blank lines and comment lines
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

    # Expect KEY=VALUE format; warn and skip malformed lines
    if [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$ ]]; then
      key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
      value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
    else
      warn "Line ${line_number}: skipping unrecognised format → '${line}'"

    fi

    # Fall back to the value defined in the file itself so the script works both
    # when variables are exported by a CI system and when the file is the sole source.
    local resolved_value="${!key:-$value}"

    if [[ -z "${!key+set}" && -z "$value" ]]; then
      # Not in env AND blank in file
      missing+=("$key")
    elif [[ -z "$resolved_value" ]]; then
      # Present in env or file but evaluates to empty string
      empty+=("$key")
    else
      log "  ✔  ${key}"
    fi

  done < "$env_file"

  local failed=0

  if [[ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    warn "The following variables are missing entirely:"
    for key in "${missing[@]}"; do

    done
    (( failed++ )) || true

    warn "The following variables are set but have no value:"
    for key in "${empty[@]}"; do

    done
    (( failed++ )) || true

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# deploy.sh — Create a timestamped release archive of the current project.
# Excludes: node_modules/, .git/
# Usage: ./deploy.sh [project-name]

set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PROJECT_NAME="${1:-$(basename "$PWD")}"           # Use argument or current dir name
TIMESTAMP="$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")"             # e.g. 20240101_120000
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="${PWD}/releases"                       # Place archive in a dedicated releases/ folder
ENV_FILE="${PWD}/.env.test"                        # Required-variable manifest

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log()     { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
log_ok()  { echo "[deploy]   ✔  $*"; }
log_err() { echo "[deploy]   ✘  $*" >&2; }
fail()    { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pre-flight checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
command -v tar &>/dev/null || fail "'tar' is required but not installed."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Environment variable validation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
validate_env() {
  local env_file="$1"
  local missing=0
  local checked=0
  local skipped=0
  # NOTE: bare (( n++ )) exits 1 when n is 0, which trips set -e.
  #       All arithmetic increments below use (( n++ )) || true to stay safe.

  log "Validating environment variables against '${env_file}'..."

  # Read every line of the file
  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "${line}" ]]; do

    # Skip blank lines and comment lines (optionally preceded by whitespace)
    [[ "${line}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]  && { (( skipped++ )) || true; continue; }
    [[ "${line}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*#  ]] && { (( skipped++ )) || true; continue; }

    if [[ "${line}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$ ]]; then
      local key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
      local file_value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"

      # 1. The key must exist in the current environment
      if [[ -z "${!key+isset}" ]]; then
        log_err "${key}  —  not set in the current environment"
        (( missing++ )) || true
        continue
      fi

      # 2. The runtime value must not be empty
      local runtime_value="${!key}"
      if [[ -z "${runtime_value}" ]]; then
        log_err "${key}  —  is set but empty"
        (( missing++ )) || true
        continue
      fi

      # 3. Warn (but don't fail) when the runtime value still matches the
      #    placeholder value recorded in .env.test
      if [[ -n "${file_value}" && "${runtime_value}" == "${file_value}" ]]; then
        log_err "${key}  —  still using the .env.test placeholder value!"
        (( missing++ )) || true
        continue
      fi

      log_ok "${key}"
      (( checked++ )) || true
    else
      log_err "Could not parse line (skipping): ${line}"
      (( skipped++ )) || true
    fi

    fail "${missing} required environment variable(s) are missing, empty, or using placeholder values. Aborting deployment."
  fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

log "  Archive : ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
log "  Source  : ${PWD}"

  local empty=()     # keys present in the file but with no value
  local checked=0

    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then

die()     { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

  local empty=()     # keys present in the file but with no value

  log "Validating environment variables from '${env_file}' ..."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

EXCLUDES=(

  "--exclude=./node_modules"

)

err()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

log "  Archive : ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
log "  Output  : ${RELEASES_DIR}/"

# Create the releases directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "${RELEASES_DIR}"

# Build the archive from the current directory
tar -czf "${RELEASES_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
  "${EXCLUDES[@]}" \

                                             # (values must be set in the shell

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

echo "========================================"
echo "  Deployment Script"
echo "========================================"
echo "  Project : ${PROJECT_NAME}"
echo "  Archive : ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "  Output  : ${OUTPUT_DIR}"
echo "========================================"

# Create the output directory if it doesn't exist

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# validate_env

# Reads every non-comment, non-blank line of ENV_MANIFEST and extracts the
# key name (the portion before the first '=').  Each key is then checked
# against the *current shell environment* — the manifest file is never

#

# empty; always prints a pass/fail result per key so CI logs are easy to scan.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
validate_env() {
  local manifest="${1}"
  local -a missing=()
  local -a keys=()
  local line key

  echo ""
  echo "[1/4] Validating environment variables..."
  echo "      Manifest : ${manifest}"

  if [ ! -f "${manifest}" ]; then
    echo "      ERROR: Manifest file '${manifest}' not found." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if [ ! -r "${manifest}" ]; then
    echo "      ERROR: Manifest file '${manifest}' is not readable." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  # - Extract only the portion before the first '=' so values are never used
  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "${line}" ]; do
    # Strip leading/trailing whitespace
    line="${line#"${line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    line="${line%"${line##*[![:space:]]}"}"

    # Skip blank lines and comments
    [[ -z "${line}" || "${line}" == \#* ]] && continue

    # Extract key name only (everything before the first '=')

    # Skip malformed lines that produced an empty key
    [[ -z "${key}" ]] && continue

    keys+=("${key}")
  done < "${manifest}"

  # Guard: manifest must declare at least one key
  if [ "${#keys[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "      ERROR: No keys found in '${manifest}'. Aborting." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

    # ${!key} performs indirect expansion — resolves the variable named by $key
    if [ -n "${!key+set}" ] && [ -n "${!key}" ]; then
      echo "      [PASS] ${key}"
    else
      echo "      [FAIL] ${key}  <-- missing or empty"
      missing+=("${key}")
    fi
  done

  echo ""
  echo "      Checked  : ${#keys[@]} variable(s)"
  echo "      Passed   : $(( ${#keys[@]} - ${#missing[@]} ))"
  echo "      Failed   : ${#missing[@]}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh – Create a timestamped release archive of the current project.
#
# Usage:   ./deploy.sh [output-dir]
#
#   output-dir   Directory where the archive will be written.
#                Defaults to the current directory.
#
# The archive excludes:
#   • node_modules/   – third-party dependencies
#   • .git/           – version-control history
#
# Pre-deployment validation:
#   Reads .env.test and asserts that every declared key has a non-empty value
#   before any archive work begins.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ── Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$(pwd)")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-.}"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
ENV_FILE=".env.test"

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()     { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()     { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
warn()    { echo "[deploy] WARN : $*" >&2; }
success() { echo "[deploy] ✓ $*"; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar &>/dev/null || err "'tar' is required but was not found in PATH."

# ── Environment validation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Validating environment variables from '${ENV_FILE}'…"

# Confirm the env file itself is present and readable.
[[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "'${ENV_FILE}' not found. Aborting deployment."
[[ -r "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "'${ENV_FILE}' exists but is not readable. Check file permissions."

missing=()   # keys that are absent from the environment entirely
empty=()     # keys that are present but set to an empty string
total=0      # count of non-comment, non-blank lines processed

while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
  # Skip blank lines and comment lines (optional leading whitespace + #).
  [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$  ]] && continue
  [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*#  ]] && continue

  # Extract the key (everything before the first '=').
  key="${line%%=*}"

  # Strip any surrounding whitespace from the key.
  key="${key#"${key%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
  key="${key%"${key##*[![:space:]]}"}"

  # Skip malformed lines that produced an empty key.
  [[ -z "$key" ]] && { warn "Skipping malformed line: '${line}'"; continue; }

  # Extract the value (everything after the first '=').
  value="${line#*=}"

  # Check 1 – key is missing from the environment entirely.
  if [[ -z "${!key+set}" ]]; then
    missing+=("$key")

  # Check 2 – key exists but its value is blank.
  elif [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
    empty+=("$key")
    log "  [EMPTY  ] ${key}"

  else
    log "  [OK     ] ${key}"
  fi

  log "  Not set in environment : ${missing[*]}"
fi
if (( ${#empty[@]} > 0 )); then
  log "  Set but empty          : ${empty[*]}"
fi

failed=$(( ${#missing[@]} + ${#empty[@]} ))
if (( failed > 0 )); then
  err "${failed} of ${total} required variable(s) failed validation. Aborting deployment."
fi

success "All ${total} required environment variable(s) are set."
log ""

# ── Output directory ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Ensure the output directory exists (create it if necessary).
if [[ ! -d "$OUTPUT_DIR" ]]; then
  log "Output directory '$OUTPUT_DIR' not found – creating it."

```bash

```
The filename is declared once at the top alongside the other config, so it's trivially changed to `.env.production` or anything else without touching any logic.

### Two new helper functions
```bash

success() { echo "[deploy] ✓ $*"; }
```
`warn` routes non-fatal notices to `stderr` without aborting. `success` gives positive confirmation with a distinct prefix — both are consistent with the existing `log`/`err` style.

### Guard clauses on the file itself
```bash
[[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "…not found…"
[[ -r "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "…not readable…"
```
Two separate checks give a precise error message: *missing* vs *wrong permissions* — two different problems that need different fixes.

### The `while IFS= read` loop
`IFS=` prevents leading/trailing whitespace from being stripped before the line is processed. `|| [[ -n "$line" ]]` handles files that don't end with a newline (common in env files edited by hand).

### Skip logic
```
^[[:space:]]*$   →  blank line
^[[:space:]]*#   →  comment (with optional indentation)
```
Both patterns allow for whitespace before the `#`, which is a common `.env` style.

### Key extraction — two-step `%%` / `#` trim
```bash
key="${line%%=*}"   # everything left of the first '='
key="${key#…}"      # strip leading whitespace
key="${key%…}"      # strip trailing whitespace
```
`%%=*` (greedy right-trim to `=`) handles values that contain `=` signs (e.g., base64 secrets) without corrupting the key.

### `${!key+set}` — the missing-vs-empty distinction
| Expression | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `[[ -z "${!key+set}" ]]` | Variable is **not set** at all (`MISSING`) |
| `[[ -z "${!key}" ]]` | Variable is set **but blank** (`EMPTY`) |

These are tracked in separate arrays so the summary can report each failure category independently. A key that is merely `export FOO=` (empty string) is a real misconfiguration distinct from a key that was never exported at all.

### `(( total++ )) \|\| true`
`set -e` would abort on any arithmetic expression that evaluates to zero (falsy). The `|| true` guard prevents that when `total` increments from 0 to 1 — a known bash footgun.

### Validation runs **before** the output directory is created or any archive work begins
The section order is: `tar` check → **env validation** → mkdir → archive. This means a bad environment is caught instantly with zero side effects on the filesystem.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh – Validate environment, then create a timestamped release archive.
#
# Usage:   ./deploy.sh [output-dir]
#
#   output-dir  Directory where the archive will be written. (default: ./dist)
#
# Pre-deployment validation:
#   Reads .env.test to discover every required environment variable key, then
#   confirms each one is set and non-empty in the current environment.
#   The script aborts with a clear error report if any variables are missing.
#
# Packaging:
#   Excludes node_modules/ and .git/ from the archive and prints a SHA-256
#   checksum of the produced file for verification.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ── Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$(pwd)")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date -u +"%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-dist}"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Directories / files to exclude from the archive
EXCLUDES=(
  "--exclude=./node_modules"
  "--exclude=./.git"
  "--exclude=./${OUTPUT_DIR}"   # avoid embedding a previous release inside the new one
  "--exclude=./deploy.sh"       # optional: remove this line to include the script itself
)

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Pre-deployment validation ──────────────────────────────────────────────

ENV_FILE=".env.test"

validate_env() {
  log "Validating required environment variables from '${ENV_FILE}'…"

  # Abort early if the spec file itself is missing
  [[ -f "${ENV_FILE}" ]] || err "'${ENV_FILE}' not found. Cannot validate environment."

  local missing=()   # accumulates names of unset / empty variables
  local total=0      # total number of required keys found in the file

  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "${line}" ]]; do
    # Skip blank lines and comment lines (lines whose first non-space char is #)
    [[ "${line}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]  && continue
    [[ "${line}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*#  ]] && continue

    # Extract the key (everything before the first '=')
    local key="${line%%=*}"

    # Skip malformed lines that produced an empty key
    [[ -z "${key}" ]] && continue

    total=$(( total + 1 ))

    # Check that the key is set AND non-empty in the current environment.
    # Using the ${!key} indirect expansion — the value is never printed.
    if [[ -z "${!key:-}" ]]; then
      missing+=("${key}")
    fi
  done < "${ENV_FILE}"

  # Report results ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  if [[ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "[deploy] ERROR: ${#missing[@]} of ${total} required variable(s) are missing or empty:" >&2
    for var in "${missing[@]}"; do
      echo "           - ${var}" >&2
    done
    echo "[deploy] Set the missing variables in your environment and re-run." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  log "  All ${total} required environment variable(s) are set. ✓"
}

# Cross-platform SHA-256 checksum (macOS ships shasum, Linux ships sha256sum)
checksum() {
  if command -v sha256sum &>/dev/null; then
    sha256sum "$1"
  elif command -v shasum &>/dev/null; then
    shasum -a 256 "$1"
  else
    log "Warning: no SHA-256 tool found, skipping checksum."
  fi
}

# ── Main ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

validate_env

log "Starting deployment packaging…"
log "  Project : ${PROJECT_NAME}"
log "  Archive : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"

# Create the output directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}" || err "Failed to create output directory '${OUTPUT_DIR}'."

# Build the archive from the current directory
tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" \
  "${EXCLUDES[@]}" \
  . \
  || err "tar failed – archive was not created."

log "Archive created successfully."

# Print size and checksum
ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" | cut -f1)"
log "  Size    : ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
log "  SHA-256 : $(checksum "${ARCHIVE_PATH}")"

log "Done. Release archive is ready at: ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh – Create a timestamped release archive of the current project.
#
# Usage:   ./deploy.sh [output-dir]
#
#   output-dir  Directory where the archive will be saved.
#               Defaults to the current directory when omitted.
#
# The archive excludes:
#   • node_modules/  – third-party dependencies
#   • .git/          – version-control history
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

set -euo pipefail

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$(pwd)")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-.}"           # First argument, or current directory

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

command -v tar &>/dev/null || err "'tar' is not installed or not on PATH."

# Resolve / create the output directory
mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}" || err "Cannot create output directory '${OUTPUT_DIR}'."
OUTPUT_DIR="$(cd "${OUTPUT_DIR}" && pwd)"   # absolute path

ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Guard against accidentally archiving into a path inside the project tree
# (would cause tar to try to include a file that is growing).
if [[ "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" == "$(pwd)"* ]]; then
  TMPDIR_OVERRIDE="$(mktemp -d)"
  ARCHIVE_PATH="${TMPDIR_OVERRIDE}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
  MOVE_AFTER=true
else

log "Output    : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"

tar \
  --exclude="./node_modules" \
  --exclude="./.git" \
  --exclude="${ARCHIVE_PATH}" \
  -czf "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" \
  -C "$(pwd)" \
  .

# Move out of the temp directory if needed
if [[ "${MOVE_AFTER}" == true ]]; then

  ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

log "  Size : ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"

### What was added — `validate_env()`

The function runs as the very first step, before any archive is created. If it fails, the script exits immediately and no `.tar.gz` is ever written.

#### File-level guards
Two checks run before parsing begins:

| Check | Error |
|---|---|

|---|---|

| `KEY=` (empty value) | Added to the `empty[]` array |
| Malformed (no `=`, empty key) | Skipped silently |
| `KEY=value` | Counted as `valid`, printed with `✔` |

Under `set -e`, arithmetic `(( expr ))` exits the script if the expression evaluates to `0` (falsy in bash arithmetic). This would have killed the script on the very first valid variable. Appending `|| true` neutralises that without disabling `set -e` globally.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh – Create a timestamped release archive of the current directory,
#             excluding node_modules/ and .git/.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ── Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROJECT_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME:-$(basename "$PWD")}"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
OUTPUT_DIR="${OUTPUT_DIR:-$PWD}"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

EXCLUDES=(
  "--exclude=./.git"
  "--exclude=./node_modules"
  "--exclude=./${ARCHIVE_NAME}"   # avoid packing a previously generated archive
)

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()  { printf '\e[1;32m[deploy]\e[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
warn() { printf '\e[1;33m[deploy]\e[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
die()  { printf '\e[1;31m[deploy]\e[0m ERROR: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar  &>/dev/null || die "'tar' is required but not found."
command -v gzip &>/dev/null || die "'gzip' is required but not found."

[[ -w "$OUTPUT_DIR" ]] || die "Output directory '${OUTPUT_DIR}' is not writable."

# ── Environment variable validation ────────────────────────────────────────
ENV_FILE="${ENV_FILE:-.env.test}"

validate_env() {
  local env_file="$1"
  local missing=()
  local empty=()
  local checked=0

  log "Validating environment variables from '${env_file}'..."

  [[ -f "$env_file" ]]  || die "Env file '${env_file}' not found."
  [[ -r "$env_file" ]]  || die "Env file '${env_file}' is not readable."

  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip blank lines and comment lines
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

    # Skip lines that are not KEY=... assignments
    [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)[[:space:]]*= ]] || continue

    local key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    # Extract everything after the first '='
    local value="${line#*=}"

    checked=$(( checked + 1 ))

    # Check the env file value itself is non-empty
    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
      empty+=("$key")
      continue
    fi

    # Also confirm the variable is exported / available in the current shell
    if [[ -z "${!key+set}" ]]; then
      missing+=("$key")
    elif [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
      empty+=("$key")
    fi

  done < "$env_file"

  # ── Report any problems ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  local failed=0

  if [[ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    warn "Variables defined in '${env_file}' but NOT set in the environment:"
    for key in "${missing[@]}"; do
      warn "  ✗ ${key}"
    done
    failed=$(( failed + 1 ))
  fi

  if [[ ${#empty[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    warn "Variables found but have EMPTY values:"
    for key in "${empty[@]}"; do
      warn "  ✗ ${key}"
    done
    failed=$(( failed + 1 ))
  fi

  [[ $failed -gt 0 ]] && die "Env validation failed — ${#missing[@]} missing, ${#empty[@]} empty. Aborting deployment."

  log "Env validation passed — ${checked} variable(s) checked. ✓"
}

validate_env "$ENV_FILE"

# ── Build archive ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Project   : ${PROJECT_NAME}"
log "Timestamp : ${TIMESTAMP}"
log "Output    : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
log "Excluding : .git  node_modules"
log "Creating archive..."

TMP_ARCHIVE="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/deploy_XXXXXX.tar.gz")"
trap 'rm -f "${TMP_ARCHIVE}"' EXIT

tar -czf "${TMP_ARCHIVE}" \
  "${EXCLUDES[@]}"        \
  -C "$PWD" .

mv "${TMP_ARCHIVE}" "${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
trap - EXIT

# ── Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" | cut -f1)"
log "Done! Archive size: ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"
log "Release archive : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh — Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
#
# Usage:
#   ./deploy.sh [output-dir]
#
#   output-dir  Optional. Directory where the archive is written.
#               Defaults to the current directory.
#
# What it does:
#   1. Resolves the project name from the current directory name.
#   2. Creates a timestamped .tar.gz archive, excluding node_modules & .git.
#   3. Prints the archive path and its SHA-256 checksum on success.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ── Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$(pwd)")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date -u +"%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-.}"          # first argument, or current directory

# Directories / files to exclude from the archive
EXCLUDES=(
  "--exclude=./.git"
  "--exclude=./node_modules"
  "--exclude=./${ARCHIVE_NAME}"   # avoid including the archive itself
)

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Preflight checks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar  &>/dev/null || err "'tar' is not installed."
command -v gzip &>/dev/null || err "'gzip' is not installed."

# Ensure the output directory exists
mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}" || err "Cannot create output directory '${OUTPUT_DIR}'."

ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# ── Build the archive ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Creating release archive..."
log "  Source  : $(pwd)"
log "  Archive : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"

tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" \
  "${EXCLUDES[@]}"         \
  .

log "Archive created successfully."

# ── Checksum ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if command -v sha256sum &>/dev/null; then

### Shebang & safety flags
```bash

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `-e` | Exit immediately on any command error |
| `-u` | Treat unset variables as errors |
| `-o pipefail` | A pipeline fails if *any* command in it fails, not just the last |

### Archive naming
```bash
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$(pwd)")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date -u +"%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

Each archive gets a **UTC ISO-8601 timestamp** in its name (e.g. `myapp-20260607T094216Z.tar.gz`), so repeated runs never overwrite a previous release.

---

```bash

  "--exclude=./node_modules"

mv "${TMP_ARCHIVE}" "${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
trap - EXIT

This avoids the classic `"file changed as we read it"` warning that occurs when the destination lives inside the directory being archived. ```bash

```bash

|---|---|

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh – Validate required environment variables, then create a
#             timestamped release archive of the current project,
#             excluding node_modules/ and .git/.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Usage:
#   chmod +x deploy.sh        (first time only)
#   ./deploy.sh               (uses default .env.test)
#   ./deploy.sh .env.prod     (pass a custom env file as the first argument)
#
# Output:
#   release-<YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS>.tar.gz in the current directory
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

set -euo pipefail

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")"
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
ENV_FILE="${1:-"${PROJECT_DIR}/.env.test"}"

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()     { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
success() { echo "[deploy] ✔  $*"; }
warn()    { echo "[deploy] ⚠  $*"; }
err()     { echo "[deploy] ✘  ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar &>/dev/null || err "'tar' is not installed or not in PATH."

# ── Step 1: Validate environment variables ───────────────────────────────────
log "────────────────────────────────────────────"
log "Step 1/2 — Validating environment variables"
log "Env file : ${ENV_FILE}"
log "────────────────────────────────────────────"

[[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "Env file not found: ${ENV_FILE}"
[[ -r "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "Env file is not readable: ${ENV_FILE}"

missing=()   # keys that are absent or empty after parsing
passed=()    # keys that carry a non-empty value
skipped=0    # blank lines + comments + malformed lines

while IFS= read -r raw_line || [[ -n "$raw_line" ]]; do

    # ── 1a. Strip leading/trailing whitespace ────────────────────────────────
    line="${raw_line#"${raw_line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    line="${line%"${line##*[![:space:]]}"}"

    # ── 1b. Skip blank lines and full-line comments ──────────────────────────
    if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" == \#* ]]; then
        (( skipped++ )) || true
        continue
    fi

    # ── 1c. Skip lines with no '=' (malformed) ───────────────────────────────
    if [[ "$line" != *=* ]]; then
        warn "Skipping malformed line (no '='): '${line}'"
        (( skipped++ )) || true
        continue
    fi

    # ── 1d. Extract the key (everything before the first '=') ────────────────
    key="${line%%=*}"
    # Strip whitespace from key
    key="${key#"${key%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    key="${key%"${key##*[![:space:]]}"}"
    # Strip optional 'export' prefix  (e.g. "export FOO=bar")
    key="${key#export }"
    key="${key#export	}"   # tab variant

    # ── 1e. Validate key is a legal shell identifier ─────────────────────────
    if [[ ! "$key" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ ]]; then
        warn "Skipping invalid identifier: '${key}'"
        (( skipped++ )) || true
        continue
    fi

    # ── 1f. Extract the value (everything after the first '=') ───────────────
    value="${line#*=}"
    # Strip inline comments: two-or-more spaces / a tab followed by '#'
    value="${value%%  \#*}"
    value="${value%%	\#*}"
    # Strip matching surrounding quotes (single or double)
    if [[ "$value" == \"*\" || "$value" == \'*\' ]]; then
        value="${value:1:${#value}-2}"
    fi
    # Strip leading/trailing whitespace from the bare value
    value="${value#"${value%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    value="${value%"${value##*[![:space:]]}"}"

    # ── 1g. Record result ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
        missing+=("$key")
    else
        passed+=("$key")
    fi

done < "$ENV_FILE"

# ── Report results ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for key in "${passed[@]}"; do
    success "${key} is set"
done

if [[ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo ""
    for key in "${missing[@]}"; do
        warn "${key} — MISSING or EMPTY"
    done
    echo ""
    err "${#missing[@]} required variable(s) are not set: ${missing[*]}"
fi

log "All ${#passed[@]} variable(s) validated. (${skipped} line(s) skipped)"

# ── Step 2: Create archive ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "────────────────────────────────────────────"
log "Step 2/2 — Building release archive"
log "Project  : ${PROJECT_DIR}"
log "Archive  : ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
log "Excluding: node_modules/, .git/"
log "────────────────────────────────────────────"

tar \
  --exclude="./node_modules" \
  --exclude="./.git" \
  --exclude="./${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
  -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
  -C "${PROJECT_DIR}" \
  . 2>&1 \
  | grep -v "file changed as we read it" \
  || true

# Verify the archive was created and is non-empty
[[ -s "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" ]] || err "Archive was not created or is empty."

ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"
log "────────────────────────────────────────────"
success "Deployment archive ready: ${ARCHIVE_NAME} (${ARCHIVE_SIZE})"
log "────────────────────────────────────────────"

warn()    { echo "[deploy] ✘  $*" >&2; }

  local empty=()     # keys present but set to an empty string

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh – Validate environment, then create a timestamped release archive.
#
# Usage:
#   ./deploy.sh [output_dir]
#
#   output_dir  Directory where the archive is written (default: ./releases)
#
# Pre-deployment validation:
#   Reads .env.test to discover every required environment variable key, then
#   checks that each key is set to a non-empty value in the current shell
#   environment.  The deployment is aborted if any variable is missing or blank.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ── Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$PWD")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-releases}"
ENV_TEMPLATE=".env.test"          # source of required variable names

# Directories / files to exclude from the archive
EXCLUDES=(
  ".git"
  "node_modules"
  "${OUTPUT_DIR}"        # avoid bundling previous releases
)

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()     { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()     { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
success() { echo "[deploy] ✔  $*"; }
warn()    { echo "[deploy] ✘  $*" >&2; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar &>/dev/null || err "tar is required but not installed."

# ── Environment variable validation ───────────────────────────────────────
validate_env() {
  local template="$1"

  [[ -f "$template" ]] || err "Env template '${template}' not found."

  log "Validating environment variables against '${template}'..."

  local missing=()   # keys that are absent from the environment
  local empty=()     # keys present but set to an empty string
  local valid=0      # count of keys that passed

  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip blank lines and comment lines (optionally indented)
    [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*#  ]] && continue
    [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$  ]] && continue

    # Extract the key (everything before the first '=')
    local key="${line%%=*}"

    # Skip malformed lines that produced an empty key
    [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue

    if [[ -z "${!key+set}" ]]; then
      # Variable is not set at all in the environment
      missing+=("$key")
    elif [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
      # Variable is set but empty
      empty+=("$key")
    else
      (( valid++ )) || true
      success "${key}"
    fi
  done < "$template"

  # ── Report problems ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  local failed=0

  if [[ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    for key in "${missing[@]}"; do
      warn "${key}  (not set)"
    done
    (( failed++ )) || true
  fi

  if [[ ${#empty[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    for key in "${empty[@]}"; do
      warn "${key}  (set but empty)"
    done
    (( failed++ )) || true
  fi

  # ── Final verdict ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  local total=$(( valid + ${#missing[@]} + ${#empty[@]} ))
  log "Result: ${valid}/${total} required variables passed."

  if [[ $failed -gt 0 ]]; then
    err "Deployment aborted — ${#missing[@]} missing, ${#empty[@]} empty. \
Set all required variables and retry."
  fi

  log "All required environment variables are present and non-empty."
}

validate_env "$ENV_TEMPLATE"

# ── Create output directory ────────────────────────────────────────────────
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"
ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# ── Build exclude flags ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EXCLUDE_FLAGS=()
for pattern in "${EXCLUDES[@]}"; do
  EXCLUDE_FLAGS+=(--exclude="./${pattern}")
done

# ── Create the archive ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Creating release archive..."
log "  Source      : $PWD"
log "  Destination : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
log "  Excluding   : ${EXCLUDES[*]}"

tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" \
  "${EXCLUDE_FLAGS[@]}" \
  -C "$(dirname "$PWD")" \
  "$(basename "$PWD")"

# ── Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | cut -f1)"
log "Done! Archive created successfully."
log "  File : ${ARCHIVE_PATH}"
log "  Size : ${ARCHIVE_SIZE}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh – Validate environment variables, then create a timestamped
#             release archive of the current project.
#
# Usage:   ./deploy.sh [output-dir]
#
#   output-dir  Optional. Directory where the archive will be saved.
#               Defaults to the current directory.
#
# Output:  <output-dir>/release-<YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS>.tar.gz
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ENV_FILE=".env.test"                        # file that declares required keys

PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$(pwd)")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S)"
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-.}"                        # first argument, or current dir

# Patterns to exclude from the archive
EXCLUDES=(
  "node_modules"
  ".git"
  ".env"
  "*.log"
  "${ARCHIVE_NAME}"   # avoid including a previously created archive
)

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log()     { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()     { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
success() { echo "[deploy] ✔  $*"; }
fail()    { echo "[deploy] ✘  $*" >&2; }

# ── Pre-flight checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

command -v tar &>/dev/null || err "'tar' is required but not installed."

# ── Environment variable validation ──────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Rules applied to every non-comment, non-blank line in ENV_FILE:
#   1. The line must follow the pattern  KEY=VALUE  (an '=' must be present).
#   2. The KEY must not be empty.
#   3. The VALUE (the part after the first '=') must not be empty or
#      consist solely of whitespace.
#
# Any violation is collected and reported together so the developer can fix
# all missing values in one pass rather than discovering them one at a time.

validate_env() {
  log "Validating environment variables from '${ENV_FILE}'…"

  [[ -f "${ENV_FILE}" ]]  || err "Required env file '${ENV_FILE}' not found."
  [[ -r "${ENV_FILE}" ]]  || err "Env file '${ENV_FILE}' exists but is not readable."

  local missing=()   # keys whose values are absent or blank
  local malformed=() # lines that don't conform to KEY=VALUE syntax
  local total=0      # total number of non-comment, non-blank lines parsed

  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "${line}" ]]; do
    # Skip blank lines and comment lines (optional leading whitespace + '#')
    [[ -z "${line}"            ]] && continue
    [[ "${line}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

    (( total++ )) || true

    # ── Rule 1: must contain '=' ─────────────────────────────────────────
    if [[ "${line}" != *=* ]]; then
      malformed+=("  line ${total}: '${line}'  ← missing '='")
      continue
    fi

    # Split on the FIRST '=' only so values may themselves contain '='
    local key="${line%%=*}"
    local value="${line#*=}"

    # ── Rule 2: key must not be blank ────────────────────────────────────
    if [[ -z "${key}" ]]; then
      malformed+=("  line ${total}: '${line}'  ← key is empty")
      continue
    fi

    # ── Rule 3: value must not be empty or whitespace-only ───────────────
    # Strip surrounding whitespace from the value before checking
    local trimmed_value="${value#"${value%%[! ]*}"}"  # leading whitespace
    trimmed_value="${trimmed_value%"${trimmed_value##*[! ]}"}"  # trailing

    if [[ -z "${trimmed_value}" ]]; then
      missing+=("  ${key}")
    fi

  done < "${ENV_FILE}"

  # ── Report results ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  local passed=true

  if [[ ${#malformed[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    fail "Malformed line(s) in '${ENV_FILE}' (expected KEY=VALUE):"
    printf '%s\n' "${malformed[@]}" >&2
    passed=false
  fi

  if [[ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    fail "The following required variable(s) have no value in '${ENV_FILE}':"
    printf '%s\n' "${missing[@]}" >&2
    passed=false
  fi

  [[ "${passed}" == false ]] && \
    err "Validation failed — set the missing values in '${ENV_FILE}' and retry."

  success "All ${total} variable(s) in '${ENV_FILE}' are present and non-empty."
}

validate_env

# ── Output directory setup ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Resolve (and create if necessary) the output directory

OUTPUT_DIR="$(cd "${OUTPUT_DIR}" && pwd)"   # absolute path

#   2. The KEY must not be empty.

#      consist solely of whitespace.
#

# all missing values in one pass rather than discovering them one at a time.

validate_env() {
  log "Validating environment variables from '${ENV_FILE}'…"

  [[ -f "${ENV_FILE}" ]]  || err "Required env file '${ENV_FILE}' not found."
  [[ -r "${ENV_FILE}" ]]  || err "Env file '${ENV_FILE}' exists but is not readable."

  local malformed=() # lines that don't conform to KEY=VALUE syntax
  local total=0      # total number of non-comment, non-blank lines parsed

    # Skip blank lines and comment lines (optional leading whitespace + '#')
    [[ -z "${line}"            ]] && continue
    [[ "${line}" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

    (( total++ )) || true

    # ── Rule 1: must contain '=' ─────────────────────────────────────────
    if [[ "${line}" != *=* ]]; then
      malformed+=("  line ${total}: '${line}'  ← missing '='")
      continue
    fi

    # Split on the FIRST '=' only so values may themselves contain '='
    local key="${line%%=*}"
    local value="${line#*=}"

    # ── Rule 2: key must not be blank ────────────────────────────────────
    if [[ -z "${key}" ]]; then
      malformed+=("  line ${total}: '${line}'  ← key is empty")
      continue
    fi

    # ── Rule 3: value must not be empty or whitespace-only ───────────────
    # Strip surrounding whitespace from the value before checking
    local trimmed_value="${value#"${value%%[! ]*}"}"  # leading whitespace
    trimmed_value="${trimmed_value%"${trimmed_value##*[! ]}"}"  # trailing

    if [[ -z "${trimmed_value}" ]]; then
      missing+=("  ${key}")

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh — Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
#
# Usage:
#   ./deploy.sh [output-dir]
#
#   output-dir  Optional. Directory where the archive will be written.
#               Defaults to the current directory.
#
# What it does:
#   1. Validates that every key declared in .env.test has a non-empty value.
#   2. Determines the project name from the current directory.
#   3. Creates a timestamped filename:  <project>-<YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS>.tar.gz
#   4. Packs every file in the project, excluding:
#        - node_modules/   (third-party dependencies)
#        - .git/           (version-control metadata)
#   5. Prints a short summary (file path + size).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$(pwd)")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S)"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-.}"                          # use first argument or cwd
ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
ENV_FILE=".env.test"                          # env file to validate against

EXCLUDES=(
  "--exclude=./node_modules"
  "--exclude=./.git"
)

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Environment validation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Reads ENV_FILE line by line and verifies that:
#   - The file exists and is readable.
#   - Every non-comment, non-blank line follows KEY=VALUE format.
#   - No key has an empty (or whitespace-only) value.
# Reports ALL missing/empty vars in one pass before exiting, so the developer
# can fix everything at once rather than playing whack-a-mole.
validate_env() {
  log "Validating environment variables from '$ENV_FILE'..."

  [[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "Env file '$ENV_FILE' not found."
  [[ -r "$ENV_FILE" ]]  || err "Env file '$ENV_FILE' is not readable."

  local missing=()   # keys that are absent or empty
  local invalid=()   # lines that don't match KEY=VALUE
  local checked=0    # total keys examined

  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip blank lines and comment lines (optional leading whitespace allowed).
    [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$  ]] && continue
    [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*#  ]] && continue

    # Every remaining line must look like:  KEY=<anything>
    if [[ ! "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)[[:space:]]*= ]]; then
      invalid+=("  ✗  (malformed) → $line")
      continue
    fi

    local key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    # Extract the part after the first '=' and strip surrounding whitespace.
    local value="${line#*=}"
    value="${value#"${value%%[! ]*}"}"   # ltrim
    value="${value%"${value##*[! ]}"}"   # rtrim

    (( checked++ ))

    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
      missing+=("  ✗  $key  (empty value)")
    else
      log "  ✓  $key"
    fi
  done < "$ENV_FILE"

  # Surface every problem at once before deciding whether to abort.
  if [[ ${#invalid[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "[deploy] ERROR: Malformed lines in '$ENV_FILE':" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "${invalid[@]}" >&2
  fi

  if [[ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "[deploy] ERROR: The following required variables are missing or empty:" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "${missing[@]}" >&2
  fi

  [[ ${#invalid[@]} -eq 0 && ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ]] \
    || err "Environment validation failed — fix the issues above, then re-run."

  log "All $checked required environment variables are set. Validation passed."
}

# ── Pre-flight checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar &>/dev/null || err "'tar' is not installed or not in PATH."

validate_env

if [[ ! -d "$OUTPUT_DIR" ]]; then
  log "Output directory '$OUTPUT_DIR' does not exist — creating it."
  mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" || err "Failed to create output directory '$OUTPUT_DIR'."
fi

# ── Build archive ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Starting release build..."
log "  Project : $PROJECT_NAME"
log "  Archive : $ARCHIVE_PATH"
log "  Excludes: node_modules/, .git/"

tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" \
  "${EXCLUDES[@]}"       \
  .

# ── Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# `du` output differs slightly between GNU and BSD; normalise with awk.
ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | awk '{print $1}')"
log "Done. Archive created successfully."
log "  Path : $ARCHIVE_PATH"
log "  Size : $ARCHIVE_SIZE"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deploy.sh — Build a timestamped release archive of the current project.
#
# Usage:
#   ./deploy.sh [output-dir]
#
#   output-dir  Optional. Directory where the archive will be written.
#               Defaults to the current directory.
#
# What it does:
#   1. Validates that every key declared in .env.test has a non-empty value.
#   2. Determines the project name from the current directory.
#   3. Creates a timestamped filename:  <project>-<YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS>.tar.gz
#   4. Packs every file in the project, excluding:
#        - node_modules/   (third-party dependencies)
#        - .git/           (version-control metadata)
#   5. Prints a short summary (file path + size).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PROJECT_NAME="$(basename "$(pwd)")"
TIMESTAMP="$(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S)"
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}-${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="${1:-.}"                          # use first argument or cwd
ARCHIVE_PATH="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
ENV_FILE=".env.test"                          # env file to validate against

EXCLUDES=(
  "--exclude=./node_modules"
  "--exclude=./.git"
)

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log()  { echo "[deploy] $*"; }
err()  { echo "[deploy] ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

# ── Environment validation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Reads ENV_FILE line by line and verifies that:
#   - The file exists and is readable.
#   - Every non-comment, non-blank line follows KEY=VALUE format.
#   - No key has an empty (or whitespace-only) value.
# Reports ALL missing/empty vars in one pass before exiting, so the developer
# can fix everything at once rather than playing whack-a-mole.
validate_env() {
  log "Validating environment variables from '$ENV_FILE'..."

  if [[ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then err "Env file '$ENV_FILE' not found.";    fi
  if [[ ! -r "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then err "Env file '$ENV_FILE' is not readable."; fi

  local missing invalid checked line key value
  missing=()   # keys that are absent or empty
  invalid=()   # lines that don't match KEY=VALUE
  checked=0    # total keys examined

  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Skip blank lines and comment lines (optional leading whitespace allowed).
    [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$  ]] && continue
    [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*#  ]] && continue

    # Every remaining line must look like:  KEY=<anything>
    if [[ ! "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)[[:space:]]*= ]]; then
      invalid+=("  ✗  (malformed) → $line")
      continue
    fi

    key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
    # Extract the part after the first '=' and strip surrounding whitespace.
    value="${line#*=}"
    value="${value#"${value%%[! ]*}"}"   # ltrim
    value="${value%"${value##*[! ]}"}"   # rtrim

    (( checked++ )) || true   # guard: (( 0++ )) == 0 (falsy) would trip set -e

    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
      missing+=("  ✗  $key  (empty value)")
    else
      log "  ✓  $key"
    fi
  done < "$ENV_FILE"

  # Surface every problem at once before deciding whether to abort.
  if [[ ${#invalid[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "[deploy] ERROR: Malformed lines in '$ENV_FILE':" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "${invalid[@]}" >&2
  fi

  if [[ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "[deploy] ERROR: The following required variables are missing or empty:" >&2
    printf '%s\n' "${missing[@]}" >&2
  fi

  if [[ ${#invalid[@]} -gt 0 || ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    err "Environment validation failed — fix the issues above, then re-run."
  fi

  log "All $checked required environment variables are set. Validation passed."
}

# ── Pre-flight checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
command -v tar &>/dev/null || err "'tar' is not installed or not in PATH."

validate_env

if [[ ! -d "$OUTPUT_DIR" ]]; then
  log "Output directory '$OUTPUT_DIR' does not exist — creating it."
  mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" || err "Failed to create output directory '$OUTPUT_DIR'."
fi

# ── Build archive ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
log "Starting release build..."
log "  Project : $PROJECT_NAME"
log "  Archive : $ARCHIVE_PATH"
log "  Excludes: node_modules/, .git/"

tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" \
  "${EXCLUDES[@]}"       \
  .

# ── Summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# `du` output differs slightly between GNU and BSD; normalise with awk.
ARCHIVE_SIZE="$(du -sh "$ARCHIVE_PATH" | awk '{print $1}')"
log "Done. Archive created successfully."
log "  Path : $ARCHIVE_PATH"
log "  Size : $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
